typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PROJECT_ID as long,
		PACKAGE_ID as long,
		PROJECT_NAME as string,
		PACKAGE_NAME as string,
		uploaddate as timestamp,
		ETLuser as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ENV = 'U') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		uploaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Project_Id as long,
		package_name as string,
		etluser as string,
		package_id as long,
		ENV as string,
		project_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		uploaddate,
		Project_Id = PROJECT_ID,
		package_name = PACKAGE_NAME,
		etluser = ETLuser,
		package_id = PACKAGE_ID,
		ENV,
		project_name = PROJECT_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
